name: socrates-monorepo
description: Socrates — Intelligent AI Tutor & Learning Platform Monorepo

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/socrates run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm run lint:server-boundaries && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:shims
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix server run test:unit && npm --prefix frontend run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:shared
scripts.test:site: node scripts/sync-site-chrome.mjs --check && node --test test/site-layout.test.mjs test/site-home.test.mjs test/site-product.test.mjs test/site-content.test.mjs test/site-motion.test.mjs
